projectDescription.text: We are a private conservation nonprofit foundation in northern Utah. Our project involves building a wildlife overpass with about eight miles of fencing on a four-lane highway that cuts through a deer and elk migration route. The project is currently at the planning stage, as we have not yet started design. The total project cost is $30 million, and we are requesting all $30 million in federal funds, with no contribution of our own.
